offering_description.value: Mines and processes potash, langbeinite and magnesium chloride in New Mexico and Utah, selling fertilizer to farms and blenders and dust-control and deicing products to distributors and industrial customers.

primary_products.value: potash fertilizer; langbeinite fertilizer; magnesium chloride; salt

customer_segment.value: B2B: farms, fertilizer blenders and distributors, deicing and dust-control buyers, industrial users

end_markets.value: agriculture; road deicing and dust control; industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: fertilizer, magnesium chloride and salt sold by the ton

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mines and processes potash ore into fertilizer and chemical products, sold to blenders and distributors; asset operator: owns and runs mines and processing plants in New Mexico and Utah

geography_served.value: US national: customers across farm regions and nationwide deicing and industrial markets

specialization.value: related lines: potash, langbeinite, magnesium chloride and salt products from mining and processing

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: fertilizer blenders and distributors that resell to farmers; direct sales: industrial and deicing customers bought directly

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining permits and environmental, mine safety and water rules from state agencies, EPA and MSHA
